testSuite.details: No test target exists by design (Decision 9, deferred to follow-up — verified by Test Audit T11 as DEFERRAL JUSTIFIED). Compensating verification: xcodebuild Debug build succeeded with 0 errors and 0 new warnings in the 8 modified files (AIProviderClient.swift, DocumentState.swift, WorkspaceManager.swift, GraphRAG.swift, InsightSession.swift, WebViewBridge.swift, EditorView.swift, ContentView.swift). 6 fixture files committed (sse-anthropic-sample.txt + 5 marker-cases) and hand-traced clean by Code Audit T9.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Build-1: xcodebuild build succeeds with 0 errors
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: ** BUILD SUCCEEDED **

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Build-2: No new compiler warnings in modified files
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: grep over xcodebuild output for warning: lines in 8 modified files returns 0

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Build-3: Existing tab.url/content/isModified read-sites unaffected
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: OpenTab.kind = .file default + clean build implies no regression

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Storage-1: No new SQLite tables created
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: TestFiles/.dde/state.db .tables shows 32 tables, none with insight* prefix; SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE name LIKE '%insight%' returns empty

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Storage-2: No writes to artifacts/ai_jobs for insight ops
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM artifacts WHERE kind LIKE 'insight%' = 0; both artifacts and ai_jobs total counts = 0; security-audit Check 10 confirmed 9 insight-tab disk-write early-returns + 2 EditorView pre-hop guards

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: GraphRAG-1: deepResearch() unchanged
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: mapReduceForFolder is additive; deepResearch() untouched in feature diff per tech-spec Decision 5

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Cap-1: 50 KB per-file truncation
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: GraphRAG.swift:191 mapReducePerFileByteCap=50*1024 enforced at L341-342; InsightSession.swift:149 perFileTruncationCapBytes=50*1024 enforced at L1027-1028

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Cap-2: 500 files per folder hard reject
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: WorkspaceManager.swift:549 insightFolderFileLimit=500 enforced at L600-624; GraphRAG.swift:199 mapReduceMaxFiles=500 defensive at L240

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Cap-3: 10 MB per-node rawBuffer
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: InsightSession.swift:147 perNodeBufferCapBytes=10*1024*1024 enforced at L580

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Cap-4: 50 MB per-session total
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: InsightSession.swift:148 perSessionBufferCapBytes=50*1024*1024 enforced at L838,857 (enforceSessionMemoryCap)

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Cap-5: 64 KB per-SSE-line
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: AIProviderClient.swift:189 maxSSELineBytes=65536 enforced byte-level during accumulation at L289 (Round-1 fix from bytes.lines)

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Cap-6: 1 MB per-SSE-event payload
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: AIProviderClient.swift:192 maxSSEEventBytes=1*1024*1024 enforced at L359 (projected-byte check)

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Cap-7: 3-retries / 60s sliding window
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: InsightSession.swift:143 retryHistory map; literal <60 at L375 + count>=3 at L376; cancel-then-retry bypass guard from Round-1 fix at L470

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: SSE-1: streamCompletion parses Anthropic SSE format correctly
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: Code Audit hand-trace against Tests/Fixtures/sse-anthropic-sample.txt: 26 onDelta calls reconstruct expected text exactly; handles content_block_delta/message_stop/error, ignores ping/message_delta, tolerates : comment lines

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: SSE-2: streamCompletion propagates HTTP errors with sanitized body
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: AIProviderClient.swift:239-252 verified by Code Audit

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: SSE-3: streamCompletion rejects oversized lines without unbounded buffering
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: Byte-level enforcement at AIProviderClient.swift:289 (Round-1 fix replaced bytes.lines with manual byte loop, ensuring cap fires DURING accumulation not post-yield)

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Security-1: API key never appears in error messages or NSLog (insight surface)
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: sanitize() at AIProviderClient.swift:421-424 wraps streaming throws L251/L318/L400; apiKeySnapshot redaction at InsightSession.swift:700-702; sanitizeForLog + %@ format specifier in WorkspaceManager bridge forwarders L1445-1452

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Security-2: markdown-it html:false + link sanitization in insight mode
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: Separate insightMd at index.html:2794-2799; link sanitizer at L2806-2823 rejects javascript:/data:/file:/vbscript:

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Security-3: All LLM-derived strings via textContent
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: Single setText utility at index.html:2875-2878 used at 9 LLM-string injection sites; only innerHTML on insight surface (L2978) feeds markdown-it output already escaped by html:false

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Security-4: CSP meta tag matches Decision 10 spec
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: index.html:21 directives match: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://cdn.jsdelivr.net; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://cdn.jsdelivr.net; connect-src 'none'; img-src 'self' data: https:; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Security-5: Mermaid securityLevel:strict per-render in insight mode
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: index.html:2941 per-render strict (also redundant initialize at L3102-3107 — flagged as code-audit m1 minor, doesn't break security)

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Security-6: XML-tag instruction isolation in system prompts
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: InsightSession.swift:915-934 + GraphRAG.swift:419-421/515-517 use identical <file path="...">...</file> + treat as DATA ONLY pattern; escapeXMLEnvelopeBreakout hand-traced clean by Security Audit

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Security-7: scope_hint validation (resolveSymlinks + standardizedFileURL containment + .md ext)
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: InsightSession.swift:728-761, GraphRAG.swift:301-329, WorkspaceManager.swift:581-620 use identical idiom with path-separator-aware containment

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Security-8: Folder scan does not follow symlinks outside folderURL
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: WorkspaceManager.scanMarkdownFiles uses .skipsHiddenFiles + .skipsPackageDescendants + resolved-path containment

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Security-9: 4th retry within 60s rejected with non-retryable
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: InsightSession.swift:374-381 sets lastErrorRetryable=false and emits 'retry rate limit'

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Security-10: NSSavePanel filename strict ASCII + .md extension forced
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: sanitizeInsightFilename strict [A-Za-z0-9_] at WorkspaceManager.swift:1617-1631 (post-T7-r1 fix); .md forced at L1571-1576

acceptanceCriteria.criterion:
Marker-1: Marker form 

---DEEP-DIVES---
 only
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: Both Swift parseMarker (InsightSession.swift:873-911) and JS parseInsightMarker (index.html:2886-2915) require boundary newlines

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Marker-2: Last-occurrence semantics
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: Swift uses range(of:options:.backwards), JS uses lastIndexOf — verified across 5 fixtures by Code Audit

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: ARC-1: All InsightSession long-lived closures use [weak self]
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: Code Audit verified 15/15 closures inside InsightSession + 3/3 Combine subscriptions in EditorView.routeInsight; bridge-side strong captures (m5) acceptable per Decision 11 §1 scope

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Cancel-1: cancel() calls activeTask?.cancel() then sets nil
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: InsightSession.swift:360-364 verified by Code Audit

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Cancel-2: closeTab cancels session before tabsStore.removeTab
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: WorkspaceManager.swift:1110-1113 — Decision 11 §4 ordering verified by Code Audit

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Cancel-3: closeTab for .insight skips save prompt
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: Branch at WorkspaceManager.swift:1110, no isModified check fired

deferredToPostDeploy.criterion: Live SSE smoke-curl against Anthropic Messages API
deferredToPostDeploy.reason: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY not present in agent environment (verified: `[ -z "$ANTHROPIC_API_KEY" ] && echo no key` returns 'no key')
deferredToPostDeploy.verificationCondition: User has KEY exported and Anthropic API is reachable
deferredToPostDeploy.verificationSteps: Run: curl -N -H 'x-api-key: $KEY' -H 'anthropic-version: 2023-06-01' -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"model":"claude-sonnet-4-6","max_tokens":256,"stream":true,"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"count from 1 to 20 with brief explanation each"}]}' https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages — confirm multiple content_block_delta lines and final message_stop. If structure differs from Tests/Fixtures/sse-anthropic-sample.txt, recapture fixture.
